## Install

```bash
pnpm add @intelligo-dev/jobs@beta
```

Enqueue, claim with `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`, retry with backoff, prune. One
fewer moving part in an operational stack that already has Postgres.

## Entry points

- `@intelligo-dev/jobs`
- `@intelligo-dev/jobs/db`
